testsAndEvidence: Include exact hash-frozen source tests, guarded composition/deploy/rollback tools, final v2 manifests, scoped rules before/after, sanitized verified receipts and deployment/live/rollback receipts after completion. Record rejected v1 hash and failure cause without presenting it as releasable.

backupMetadataOnly.limitation: Logical collection backup ran during an external rename; targeted preimages and immutable rename receipt supplement timing. Backup is Firestore only, not Storage/Auth.

tagPolicy: After approved deployment and live verification, create a dated release tag on the final scoped release commit. Do not move prior tags. The previous Git checkpoint is not claimed to reconstruct ACTIVE revision73; exact rollback is pinned to the saved original source generation/archive hash and ruleset.
